title: Code Your Future — Launch-specific AI-use guidance (volunteer contribution)
notes: Recommended first volunteer candidate. Code Your Future teaches people to code for free and says remote contributions are welcome. Issue #1902 is currently Open, sized 1–4 hours, and requests Launch-specific AI guidance in prep materials. Issue is several months old, so first ask maintainers whether it is still wanted. Read contribution guide and AI-use guidance before drafting. Public GitHub contribution only; keep private identity out. No comment/application/PR made, no account required beyond existing GitHub, no payment, no accepted commitment. Sources: https://github.com/CodeYourFuture/curriculum/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md ; https://curriculum.codeyourfuture.io/guides/ai-usage/ ; https://github.com/CodeYourFuture/curriculum/issues/1902
